entries.value: Shows which Dex workflows are being used so the system can improve from real behavior.
prerequisites: The Dex analytics MCP server is registered locally.
trade_offs: Usage signals are only as complete as the events the local system records.

entries.value: Makes calendar pressure and meeting context available to planning and preparation workflows.
prerequisites: Local calendar access is authorized and the server is registered.
trade_offs: Calendar results depend on operating-system permissions and the freshness of local calendars.

entries.value: Keeps career evidence and development work consented, sourced and reviewable.
prerequisites: The career capability is enabled and its local data paths exist.
trade_offs: Career outputs remain bounded by the evidence the person has chosen to capture.

entries.value: Moves approved customizations through Dex's receipt-backed lifecycle instead of editing the vault ad hoc.
prerequisites: A compatible migration plan and lifecycle service are available.
trade_offs: Migration remains confirm-gated and may refuse changes that cannot be safely reversed.

entries.value: Brings meeting records into Dex for processing without relying on manual transcript copying.
prerequisites: Granola access is connected and authorized by the person.
trade_offs: Meeting coverage depends on the upstream Granola account and transcript availability.

entries.value: Turns observed friction into a ranked, inspectable backlog of system improvements.
prerequisites: The local improvements store is available.
trade_offs: Ranking is advisory and still needs a person to choose what should change.

entries.value: Coordinates first-run setup through explicit, locally verified onboarding steps.
prerequisites: Dex is running from a writable local vault during onboarding.
trade_offs: Setup quality depends on the person supplying accurate preferences and granting chosen permissions.

entries.value: Connects customer relationship data to Dex so deal context can support planning and follow-through.
prerequisites: Pipedrive is explicitly connected and its local server is registered.
trade_offs: External records depend on Pipedrive availability, and writes remain opt-in and confirmation-gated.

entries.value: Builds truthful application material from consented career evidence rather than invented claims.
prerequisites: Consented career evidence exists in the local career space.
trade_offs: The server cannot fill evidence gaps without the person's review and additional source material.

entries.value: Carries sourced context across sessions so repeated work does not restart from an empty chat.
prerequisites: The local session-memory store is available.
trade_offs: Remembered context can become stale and must retain clear provenance.

entries.value: Provides the validated task, project, person and company operations that core Dex workflows rely on.
prerequisites: A Dex vault and its portable path contract are available.
trade_offs: Mutations remain bounded by confirmation, validation and the local vault's current structure.

entries.value: Checks for relevant upstream capability changes several times a day without manual polling.
prerequisites: The learning automation launch agent is installed on macOS.
trade_offs: The check is periodic, so upstream changes are not surfaced instantly.

entries.value: Prompts a daily review so observed friction can become durable learning.
prerequisites: The learning automation launch agent is installed on macOS.
trade_offs: A scheduled prompt still depends on the person choosing to review and adopt useful changes.

entries.value: Keeps Granola meeting material synchronized frequently enough for timely preparation and closeout.
prerequisites: Granola is connected and the meeting-intelligence launch agent is installed on macOS.
trade_offs: Sync freshness depends on both the upstream service and the local machine being able to run the job.

entries.value: Runs a nightly health smoke check so breakage can surface before a person depends on the system.
prerequisites: The nightly smoke launch agent is installed on macOS.
trade_offs: A nightly check can detect known failures but cannot prove every workflow is healthy.

entries.value: Creates a scheduled recovery copy of the person's vault at a time they choose.
prerequisites: Backup setup is complete and its destination has been verified.
trade_offs: A schedule is not proof of recovery; the person must still test that a backup can be restored.

entries.value: Provides local connection custody and provider metadata, but its person-facing doorway remains unavailable.
prerequisites: A reviewed person-facing doorway must be released before this engine can be used.
trade_offs: The engine is shipped groundwork and must not be recommended as currently usable.

entries.value: Keeps people and entity context warm when it matters and cools stale signals over time.
prerequisites: Entity indexing and relationship data are available locally.
trade_offs: Temperature is a prioritization signal, not an objective measure of relationship importance.

entries.value: Defines the concrete promises Dex health checks use to catch silent reliability failures.
prerequisites: Dex Doctor can inspect the relevant local runtime evidence.
trade_offs: A promise only detects the failure modes its evidence and thresholds explicitly cover.

entries.value: Contains a richer meeting and ritual intelligence engine that is code-complete but not wired into the live product.
prerequisites: The parked engine would need an approved live integration before it could serve users.
trade_offs: This capability is parked and must not be presented as currently available.

entries.value: Coordinates session startup, safety, context injection, maintenance and closeout around the user's work.
prerequisites: Claude Code hooks are installed and enabled for the Dex vault.
trade_offs: Hook behavior depends on the host honoring the configured lifecycle events and local permissions.
